rationale: Houthis seize Perim island (Red Sea chokepoint) continues shipping/energy risk affecting Atlantic trade; Israel-Hezbollah escalation continues; other events distant or routine.

top_events.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
top_events.label: Houthis seize Perim island Red Sea route
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthis capture strategic Perim island on Bab al-Mandab Strait, tightening control over major shipping lane. Continues indirect threat to Atlantic shipping and energy costs.

top_events.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
top_events.label: Israel destroys major Hezbollah underground base
top_events.summary: Powerful blast equivalent to magnitude 4.1 earthquake destroys underground base in Lebanon. Continues regional escalation with indirect energy market risk for Portugal.

top_events.title: Five dead and dozens injured in coach crash in Swiss Alps
top_events.label: Coach crash kills five in Swiss Alps
top_events.summary: Tourist coach carrying Dutch passengers overturns in southeastern Swiss Alps, killing five and injuring dozens. Tragic but no direct impact on Portugal.

short_summary: Houthis seize Mokha port near key strait

most_significant_event.label: Houthis seize Mokha port near key strait
most_significant_event.summary: Capture brings Iran-backed group closer to controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital shipping route for Atlantic-connected energy and goods, raising supply chain risks for Portugal.
most_significant_event.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
